targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM test_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(correct_answers) / NULLIF(SUM(answered_questions), 0), 0) AS value FROM test_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

SELECT started_at AS time, 100.0 * correct_answers / NULLIF(answered_questions, 0) AS accuracy_percent FROM test_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND answered_questions > 0 ORDER BY started_at

SELECT assigned_difficulty::text AS difficulty, COUNT(*) AS answered, 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_correct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accuracy_percent FROM test_answers a JOIN test_sessions s ON s.id = a.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.answered_at) GROUP BY assigned_difficulty ORDER BY assigned_difficulty

SELECT anonymous_session_id, started_at, completed_at, topics, requested_questions, answered_questions, correct_answers, ROUND(100.0 * correct_answers / NULLIF(answered_questions, 0), 1) AS accuracy_percent, completed, ended_early FROM test_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100
